title: SMITE: Enhancing Fairness in LLMs through Optimal In-Context Example Selection via Dynamic Validation
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and demographic parity (specifically related to sex) within tabular classification tasks. While fairness is an ethical concept, the paper does not evaluate models on religious, theological, or philosophical moral reasoning frameworks; it utilizes standard statistical metrics and datasets (Adult, COMPAS) for bias mitigation.
